newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Foods earns A$70 mln on sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Foods earns A$70 mln on sale.

text.p: Food and drinks manufacturer National Foods Ltd said on Wednesday the sale of its NationalPak business would generate a book profit of about A$70 million.
National Foods confirmed the sale of NationalPak's Australian and New Zealand businesses to U.S.-based First Brands Corp for A$206 million, announced earlier by First Brands.
The sale price represented an earnings before interest and tax multiple of 11 times, it said.
National Foods said it would use the funds from the sale of NationalPak to invest in its core business activities of food and beverage.

NationalPak, which makes household consumer products under brand names such as Glad and Chux, had a sales turnover of A$158.5 million and earnings before interest and tax of A$18.8 million for the 1996/97 fiscal year ended June 30.
National Foods said in a statement it did not believe it could add further value for shareholders by keeping NationalPak.
It said First Brands, which owned the Glad brand internationally and other consumer products, would provide expanded opportunities for the the business.
National Foods managing director Max Ould said the funds generated by the sale would be invested in the company's diary foods and juice businesses.
"We're not ready to announce exact details of the investments, but they will stay within the current categories," Ould told Reuters.
